purpose: DOCUMENTARY_ONLY: compare two explicitly hypothetical strict single-byte interpretations of the same retained schema and identify ASCII-invariant technical definitions without identifying/correcting the actual encoding.
authorization: Root authorizes this new separately frozen comparison after preserving initial UTF8 failure and completed header boundary. Scope and source must receive independent review before one invocation. No existing source/profile/benchmark/protocol is amended.
interpretation_limits: Both are hypotheses, not encoding detection. Success or readability does not identify author-intended encoding.
Original declared UTF8 failure remains unchanged. Codec failure preserves exact type/offset, without trying any other codec or replacement.
Both single-byte hypotheses preserve ASCII bytes, but agreement only supports the byte-level/documentary text invariant; it does not validate every scientific meaning.
Any nonASCII cell, differing cell or semantic dependency on it remains UNBOUND, even if both hypothetic strings match. No normalization, alias matching or unit conversion.
algorithm: Verify same retained object size/SHA256/MD5 before interpretation; no network.
Attempt both named strict decoders once. Record started/completed stages truthfully; never execute formulas or follow links.

For successful hypotheses parse complete CSV with semicolon/doublequote/doubledquote/noescape/strict using StringIO(newline="") so Unicode NEL is not silently treated as a record break. CR/LF and quoted record framing use csv.reader only; no splitlines or whitespace normalization.
Require the exact previously observed eleven literal ASCII header labels. Compare physical record spans and row widths under both. No winner is selected.

For eleven-column records retain internal ASCII-invariant cells for categories, entry, symbol, unit, datatype, requirement, comments; withhold all examples-column values. NonASCII/differing cells receive status-only row/column locators. Other-width records remain structurally unbound; no fill-down/inheritance/row skipping repair.

Internal selected comments may contain empirical examples and are explicitly exposed as documentation; they are not a public export. Public report uses own paraphrase and necessary selected field labels/citations, never arbitrary example values/fulltext.
No measurement unit counts are inferred from schema records. Differences/omissions and dependence on unknown cell meanings remain explicit.
whole_document_exposure: Full source bytes, both complete decoded hypothetical texts and all parsed schema cells (including potentially empirical examples/options/comments) are machine-accessible. The researcher may inspect full documentation to understand ASCII-invariant prose, with incidental numerical documentary exposure recorded. Withheld examples-column projection is not absence of acquisition/decoding exposure and does not guarantee comments contain no examples. No claim that this or derivatives remain untouched blind evidence.
public_output: Fixed source/receipt identities; codec/parser stage statuses; structural record/column and ASCII/nonASCII difference counts; own-paraphrase report and necessary selected field labels/record citations. Internal full selected-cell projection and raw CSV remain ignored, not published.
